title: AIB PHY hardware v2.0 (chipsalliance/aib-phy-hardware)
_note: chipsalliance/aib-phy-hardware, the AIB 2.0 rev1.1 PHY (Intel, Apache-2.0): the adapter (tx/rx channels, FIFOs, DBI, BERT, shift-register config), the Avalon configuration interface, the CDR / phase-adjust / offset-calibration FSMs, redundancy muxing and the aib_top / aib_channel digital tops, over the behavior/ clock-cell models.  Sources follow rtl/bca/AIB2.0_RTL_filelist.f: src/rtl/**, behavior/ and ana_models/.  ROWS are the src/rtl and behavior modules only (sweep_paths): ana_models/ holds the behavioural IO / DLL / PVT-monitor models (`real` arithmetic, `#` timing controls, non-blocking initials), which read_slang refuses and whose co-sim against a timing model is not a reader verdict -- they stay in the closures of the tops that instantiate them.  Two stale copies at the top of msv_models/ (aibio_rxdll_cbb.sv, aibio_txrx_cbb.sv; the filelist takes DLL/RX_DLL/ and TXRX/) are excluded as sources, otherwise read_slang stops at a duplicate definition.  v1.0/rev1 (the AIB 1.0 PHY) and the maib_rev1.1 FPGA-side wrapper are not in this family.
